item.title: 4 takeaways from No. 23 Alabama's 100-77 loss to No. 19 Florida
item.description: No. 23 Alabama dropped another game on the road, losing its fifth straight against No. 19 Florida by a score of 100-77. The Crimson Tide kept the game within arm's reach for most of the first half, but a Gator scoring run blew the game open, and Alabama never could close the gap.
